name: @narduk-enterprises/narduk-charts
description: NardukCharts — Vue 3 SVG charting for dashboards and trading-grade market UIs (TypeScript, themable, accessible). Package: @narduk-enterprises/narduk-charts.

scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && NC_ENTRY=line vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=bar vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=pie vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=candle vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=studies vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && rm -f dist/entry-*.css
scripts.build:only: vite build && NC_ENTRY=line vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=bar vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=pie vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=candle vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts && NC_ENTRY=studies vite build --config vite.entries.config.ts

//overrides: Security-only pins for transitive advisories (narduk-charts#15). Each stays INSIDE its dependent's declared major, so no consumer range is broken: brace-expansion 5.x is dual ESM/CJS and still satisfies minimatch's require(); fast-uri stays on 3.x for ajv; postcss stays on 8.x for vite/tailwind. Drop an entry once every dependent resolves a fixed version on its own.
author: narduk
